new.name: EDM2 (mask + time gap, no ViT tokens)
bullets: 3.32M params, binary target, baseline mask + time gap conditioning, no ViT tokens
Arm C of three: trained the full 245 kimg budget, val-selected at kimg 98 (EMA 0.05)

headline: consensus Dice 0.639 -> 0.576 (-0.064); consensus surface Dice 0.888 -> 0.786 (-0.102); per-sample Dice 0.555 -> 0.533 (-0.022)
takeaways: Final checkpoints: all three EDM2 arms trained the full 245 kimg budget on the same pairs and were val-selected by consensus Dice (46 val pairs, carry-forward 0.721): C (binary target, no ViT tokens) 0.579 at kimg 98 EMA 0.05, featured here; B (SDF target + ViT tokens) 0.558 at kimg 12 EMA 0.05 and degrading steadily after that (later snapshots below 0.35); on the 25 shared test pairs, in EDM2's own scoring frame, B scores consensus Dice 0.577 vs C 0.580 and A 0.466 (carry-forward 0.677); A (binary target + ViT tokens) 0.460 at kimg 98 EMA 0.05. Evaluated here with 64 samples per pair vs the flow model's 1000.

Phase 4 conditioning ablations (25 test pairs over 18 patients, patient-level means, delta = knockout minus full context, 95% CI from a paired patient-level bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 2026): removing the baseline mask collapses both arms to an empty forecast (C 0.611 -> 0.000, delta -0.611 [-0.701, -0.499]; A 0.473 -> 0.000, delta -0.473 [-0.587, -0.354]); fixing the time gap at the train median of 682 days has no measurable effect (C 0.611 -> 0.604, delta -0.006 [-0.021, +0.010]; A 0.473 -> 0.486, delta +0.014 [-0.010, +0.038]); substituting another patient's ViT tokens has no measurable effect (A 0.473 -> 0.469, delta -0.003 [-0.011, +0.003]).

Interpretation: both arms rely on the baseline mask alone. The time gap and the ViT tokens are not measurably used (their 95% CIs straddle zero); the mask knockout is the only one whose CI excludes zero.

Phase 0 conditioning-signal probe (ViViT repo): no ViT tap showed growth-predictive signal on the frozen-encoder classifier probe -- best cross-validated ROC-AUC 0.52 vs 0.57 for the collapsed-embedding control -- consistent with tokens not improving forecast Dice here.

Bottom line: the diffusion forecaster trails flow D040 (consensus Dice 0.576 vs 0.639 on each model's own test pairs, flow frame; paired on the 25 shared pairs 0.576 vs 0.677, delta -0.101, 95% CI [-0.230, -0.007]) and its own carry-forward baseline on those 25 pairs (0.675; deterministic forecaster 0.667), and ViT-token conditioning is inert: the token arms (A, B) score no better than the no-token arm on val, and the knockouts show the tokens are not used.

Conditioning-knockout check on arm A (binary target + ViT tokens), same kimg 98 checkpoint: consensus Dice 0.473 (full context) -> 0.469 (another patient's tokens substituted), delta +0.003, 95% CI [-0.003, +0.011] (patient-level bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 2026, n=18 patients): the token arm does not use its tokens (95% CI straddles zero, no significant effect). The featured model here, EDM2 (mask + time gap, no ViT tokens), has no tokens by construction and was not itself part of this knockout.
